name: Hatori Honami
source:
A sheltered young woman who’s a bit of a daydreamer in everything she does.
After hearing positive online reviews about a massage parlor, she visits for beauty treatments and finds herself hopelessly hooked on their techniques.

Rather than simply preferring a reliable man, she has a tendency to be clingy, and ends up surrendering herself—body and soul—to the protagonist, who takes the lead in everything.
